sanskrit_verse:
राजा कृत्वा पुरे स्थानं ब्राह्मणान् न्यस्य तत्र तु /
त्रैविद्यं वृत्तिमद् ब्रूयात् स्वधर्मः पाल्यताम् इति // YajñS_2.185
transliteration: rājā kṛtvā pure sthānaṃ brāhmaṇān nyasya tatra tu / traividyaṃ vṛttimad brūyāt svadharmaḥ pālyatām iti
sph_interpretive_translation: The King having established a settlement in the city and installed Brahmins there, should declare: 'One who possesses the three knowledges and conducts himself righteously shall uphold his own dharma.'
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from conscious installation by the sovereign
Causation arises through alignment with svadharma
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by triadic knowledge and conduct
Consciousness alignment emerges through rightful placement and declaration
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler establishes territory AND installs brahmin THEN declare svadharma enforcement protocol
IF individual possesses traividya AND exhibits righteous conduct THEN assign svadharma guardianship role
IF svadharma declaration made THEN all subjects within jurisdiction must align with declared dharma
IF misalignment detected THEN initiate consciousness-realization process NOT punitive action
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, this verse mandates that the highest judicial body recognize only those declarations made under authentic sovereign establishment. The court must verify whether the ruler has properly installed qualified Brahmins and publicly declared svadharma protection. Responsibility thresholds are not based on intent or harm but on alignment capacity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa lies in the factual establishment of sacred order through installation and declaration. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential unfoldment: first installation, then declaration, then observance. Proportional responsibility correlates with knowledge possession and behavioral integrity. There is no punitive consequence; deviation triggers realignment processes rooted in consciousness recognition rather than imposed correction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Reconnect subject with original dharmic resonance field
Establish completion cycle until natural alignment resumes
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma is hereby restored through rightful installation and conscious declaration. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
